sections.title: 1. What this doc is and how it was built
bullets: Fifth of 6 case-study docs (3a–3f). Same format as before. Covers H2 Topic 3.1 and H1 Topic 1.1 (same content; H1 1.1.1 also asks 'what is SD', covered by 3a slot 1).
16 case-study slots; five 'varying success' slots (waste, slums, reimaging, elderly, women) each have a succeeded and a failed case, so 21 cases. 22 pages.
Built with tools/build_case_studies.py from tools/data/case_studies_3e.json; charts 3_1_*.png; checked with tools/check_docx.py.

sections.title: 2. Assumptions
bullets: Liveability and elderly/women slots use the most recent data found (2022–2024).
A few background points are general knowledge rather than from the listed sources (e.g. Korea's pension system starting in the late 1980s; the EIU index's use for expatriate pay).
Same limits as before: no photos, and figures come from search results quoting each source.

rows: Population 16.5 million (Macrotrends) vs 20+ million (other sources); the doc gives the range.
'Wells ~67%' is the remainder after Cutzamala (~25%) and Lerma (~8%); one source says Cutzamala is 28%.
115 deaths (AFP); cause disputed (waste-to-energy works blamed by residents).
Toilet ratio 1:1,440 (2006) is from a UN report cited in a study; other sources give 1:1,400–1,450. Population 700,000–1 million.
National hectares achieved were not found; the chart uses one district (Rangkasbitung).
'30,000 evicted' covers several waterfront communities, not Otodo-Gbame alone (doc says so).
2.9% fall in harassment comes from a blog citing a study; survey figures are from 2014 and 2016.
Expo 2020 Dubai. Alternative: Singapore's Marina Bay or Jurong Lake District.
Paris 2024 (legacy still early). Alternative: an older but proven case (e.g. Bilbao), though pre-2015.
Both use Delhi (issues, then strategy). Could swap one for another city.
